title.en: Flowering Plum in Moonlight and Snow

image.edit: Trimmed the dark photographic background around the object, then resized.

basis.en: Ming dynasty painting; the painter was active in the 16th century. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 明代绘画，画家活跃于 16 世纪。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: On brown silk, an old plum tree rises from the bottom, its crooked branches scattered with small pale blossoms, and a round moon glows near the top beside a column of inscription.
alt.zh: 在褐色的绢上，一株老梅从底部升起，虬曲的枝条上缀着小小的淡色花朵；顶部一轮圆月在一行题字旁微微发亮。

note.en: Liu Shiru was a Ming painter who specialised in plum blossom, a flower that opens in late winter, often while snow is still on the branches; in Chinese painting it stands for endurance and renewal. Here the moon and the blossoms are both small pale lights on dark silk, and they seem to answer each other.
note.zh: 刘世儒是专攻梅花的明代画家。梅在冬末开放，常常枝上还带着雪，在中国画里象征坚忍与复苏。这里的月亮和花朵都是暗色绢面上小小的淡色光点，彼此像在呼应。
